claims.head: Johansson (#20) and Johansson (#42) get the Nazar assignment
claims.call: The Red Wings’ P3 (Johansson (#20) and Johansson (#42)) spends at least 45% of its 5-on-5 time against the Blackhawks’ third line.
claims.body: At home, the Red Wings keep sending Johansson (#20) and Johansson (#42) out against opponents’ third lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Todd McLellan has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ third lines. Tonight the Blackhawks’ third line is Moore, Nazar and Donato.
claims.nums: At home: 45% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against third lines, about 26% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Todd McLellan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Blackhawks’ third line.

notes.text: Bowen Byram is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Wyatt Kaiser has taken his spot beside Artyom Levshunov.
Dominic Toninato was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Ryan Donato and Oliver Moore.
Artyom Levshunov is no longer playing on the power play: 4% of the team’s power-play time in 10 games, down from 59% last season.
Simon Edvinsson has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Ben Chiarot has taken his spot beside Moritz Seider.
Michal Postava was added to the roster on Oct 23.
